extraction_notes: Target identity is retained exactly from job metadata: BSS138K, ElecSuper, n-channel MOSFET.
The datasheet title is taken from the p. 1 heading and the document revision is Rev-1.3. All seven PDF pages were examined.

Electrical-characteristic values are transcribed from p. 3 at the stated conditions and converted to SI units where needed. The published Ciss, Coss, and Crss typical values are 25 pF, 9.7 pF, and 2.2 pF; the corresponding maximum values are 50 pF, 22 pF, and 5 pF and are retained here in this note because each schema field stores one value.
Every published RDS(on) VGS/ID row is represented with both its typical value and inclusive maximum: 1.5/1.9 ohm at 10 V, 0.4 A; 1.6/2.5 ohm at 4.5 V, 0.2 A; and 2.73/4.5 ohm at 2.5 V, 0.1 A.
The body-diode schema field uses the inclusive maximum of 1.5 V at IS = 0.5 A; the same table also publishes a typical value of 0.86 V at that condition.

Curve points are compact direct readings from the supplied raster plots on p. 4 and p. 5. No points were generated by interpolation between plotted readings. Figure conditions are preserved as stated; where a typical figure does not state temperature, that omission is explicit rather than inferred.
